author: skylenet
content:
We do have a bunch of data about the nodes (hardware), CL, EL ... and also the JSON RPC snooper on the engine API for duration metrics on engine_newPayload (which is mainly the same that benchmarkoor does to calc MGas/s). I guess that's enough? 

So basically https://lab.ethpandaops.io/ethereum/execution/timings + https://lab.ethpandaops.io/ethereum/execution/payloads (payload size) you can get the MGas/s for each client if we have that data on the devnets. CC <@84562395988508672>
